title: False Positives and Innovation Incentives: Contracting for Noisy Experimentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many data-driven organizations, employees propose product changes that are launched only after passing noisy online experiments, and their compensation is often tied to successful launches. Because even low-value features may appear successful by chance, such launch-based incentives can encourage agents to conduct experiments that reduce total surplus. We study this problem in a principal-agent model in which an agent with private knowledge about feature quality chooses whether to conduct a costly experiment and is compensated through an affine contract consisting of a launch-contingent bonus and a long-run value-sharing component, subject to limited liability. We evaluate each contract by the largest fraction of the principal's full-information payoff that it guarantees uniformly across the agent's private knowledge. Our analysis reveals a fundamental tension between experimental noise and limited liability in incentive design. Launc

translated_title: 假阳性与创新激励：针对噪声实验的契约设计
translated_abstract: 在许多数据驱动的组织中，员工提出的产品变更只有在通过带有噪声的在线实验后才会被上线，而他们的薪酬往往与成功上线挂钩。由于即使是低价值的功能也可能偶然显得成功，这种基于上线的激励可能促使代理人进行降低总剩余的实验。我们在一个委托-代理模型中研究这一问题：拥有关于功能质量私有信息的代理人选择是否进行成本高昂的实验，并通过一个由上线条件奖金和长期价值分享成分组成的仿射契约获得报酬，同时受到有限责任约束。我们用每份契约在代理人所有私有信息类型下一致保证的委托人全信息收益的最大比例来评估契约。我们的分析揭示了激励设计中实验噪声与有限责任之间的根本性张力。
tldr: 该论文通过委托-代理模型研究数据驱动组织中基于上线成败的激励契约设计，揭示了实验噪声与有限责任之间的根本性张力——上线奖金激励可能促使拥有私有信息的代理人进行降低总剩余的实验。
en_tdlr: Using a principal-agent model of noisy experimentation with privately informed agents and limited liability, this paper reveals a fundamental tension in incentive design: launch-contingent bonuses can induce agents to run experiments that reduce total surplus, and contracts are evaluated by the fraction of the principal's full-information payoff they uniformly guarantee.
